candidate.title: MiR‐CLIP
candidate.scope: The single miR-CLIP workflow in the assigned Illumina poster row, interpreted at schematic resolution with the matching miR-CLIP catalogue description and the abstract of Imig et al., PMID 25531890. Inventory: modified capture probe (Biotin/Psoralen key), RNA-protein complex, probe-associated miRNA–mRNA complex captioned Psoralen-crosslinked before irradiation, combined UV 254 nm/365 nm block, Ago2 immunoprecipitation, RNA extraction, streptavidin-biotin affinity isolation, reverse transcription, terminal cDNA. This is one linear retained route with a capture-probe reagent input; no alternative workflow, mixing, or split is depicted. The left miR-CLIP overview icon repeats the method concept and is not another processing branch. The adjacent Pol II CLIP, eCLIP, partial HITS-CLIP row and right-side chemical structures belong to surrounding poster context. The pre-UV crosslinked caption is explicitly resolved in c_crosslink_timing. The primary evidence supplied is abstract-only, not a full-text protocol; this record does not claim to describe every implementation or specify a particular miRNA sequence.

unknowns.question: Which individual molecular crosslinks are formed by 254 nm and by 365 nm, and in what relative irradiation order in the depicted implementation? The diagram combines the wavelengths and the supplied primary abstract reports photo-crosslinking without assigning them. Primary methods or a directly annotated primary figure would be needed to resolve this; the combined schematic operation remains interpretable.

How is streptavidin-bound probe-linked RNA made available for reverse transcription, and what happens to the probe-target linkage or probe sequence in the final insert? The schematic and catalogue connect selected RNA to cDNA without describing this interface. Primary library-preparation text would be needed to specify release, linkage fate or insert structure; no chimera architecture or exact site readout is asserted.

checks.rationale: Independent inspection covers all eight states, six local operations, thirteen material routes, the sole method scope, paper association, timing correction and two unknowns. Probe association is the only multi-input operation and joins reagent and target-containing material, rather than collapsing separately processed branches. Ago2 support capture, RNA recovery, subsequent streptavidin attachment and the broad RNA-to-cDNA interface agree across adjacent records. No depicted branch or transformation is omitted. The basic photo-crosslink timing is explicitly corrected without moving the drawn route or assigning individual wavelength chemistry. Primary evidence is correctly limited to an abstract. The review is bound to the inspected candidate by its canonical JSON SHA256, matching the caller context. No consequential scientific revision or blocking research question remains at the declared schematic scope.
